description:
ECB key interest rates. Source: Bundesbank.

Parameters:
- start/end: YYYY-MM-DD
- recent: number of most recent periods
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Key response fields (German names):
- zinssatz_hauptrefinanzierungssatz: main refinancing rate (the ECB's key rate)
- zinssatz_einlagefazilitaet: deposit facility rate
- zinssatz_spitzenrefinanzierungsfazilitaet: marginal lending facility rate
name: macro_ecb_policy_rates
title: ECB Policy Rates
